instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz mit dem Verb im simple past.
instruction.sound: Fervollständige den Satz mit dem Werb im <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>simple past</lang>.

atoms.b: Yesterday, my sister's origami boat ((sinks ++sank hit sweat)) in the river.
This morning, my sister ((hit bets ++bet betted)) that she could run faster than me.
Last month, my father accidentally ((hitted sank sunk ++hit)) our mailbox with his car.
Last summer, my uncle ((++sweat hit bet sweated )) more than ever before.

instruction.text: Schreibe das Verb im simple past in die Lücke.
instruction.sound: Schreibe das Werb im <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>simple past</lang> in die Lücke.

atoms.b: Yesterday, after the sun set, the temperature ((sank)) rather quickly.
One time, I ((bet)) a friend 5 pounds on our test results, which was a big mistake.
During last night's thunderstorm, the lightning ((hit)) a tree in our garden.
Yesterday afternoon, it was extremely hot at the beach, therefore I ((sweat)) a lot.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz mit dem past participle des Verbs.
instruction.sound: Fervollständige den Satz mit dem <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>past participle</lang> des Verbs

atoms.b: How many of the ships of the British Royal Navy have ((sink ++sunk sank hit)) in the last 100 years?
I have only ever ((betted bets ++bet hit)) with my friends if money was not involved.
My friends and I have never ((++hit hits hitted sunk)) each other or anyone else.
Although last summer was already hot, I believe that I have never ((sweated ++sweat bet sweats)) as much as this year.

instruction.text: Schreibe das past participle des Verbs in die Lücke.
instruction.sound: Schreibe das <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>past participle</lang> des Verbs in die Lücke.

atoms.b: Has the treasure really ((sunk)) to the bottom of the ocean?
Have you ever ((bet)) on a game with your friends?
In 30 years of having her driving licence, my mother has never ((hit)) an animal once.
Have you ever not ((sweat)) during one of your runs?
